functions.name: update-work-order
functions.description: Partially modify work order line items, assignments, status, or scheduling while preserving omitted fields.

workOrderId.description: Opaque identifier of the work order to modify.

items.description: Owner identifier.

schedule.description: Complete replacement schedule; omitted end in timed mode clears the existing timed end.

startAt.description: Replacement start instant with offset and whole-second precision.

endAt.description: Replacement end instant, not before start; omission clears it.

endDate.description: Provider all-day end calendar date, not before start; no inclusivity adjustment.

lineItems.description: Complete replacement line collection; [] requests removing all lines.

cost.description: Unit cost in account monetary units.

price.description: Unit selling price in account monetary units.

productId.description: Optional catalog product or line reference.

description.description: Line description; empty text clears it.

items.description: Replacement work order line.

relatedRecordIds.description: Replacement related record IDs; [] removes relationships.

items.description: Related record identifier.

changes.description: Partial changes; omission preserves fields, null is not accepted.

FunctionInput_jobnimbus_updateworkorder.description: Work order identity and partial changes to apply.

id.description: Identifier of the updated work order.

status.description: Actual resulting status code when returned.

statusName.description: Actual resulting status label when returned.

FunctionOutput_jobnimbus_updateworkorder.description: Identity and resulting status of the updated work order.

tags.instructions: Find an ID with `list-work-orders` and inspect it with `get-work-order`. Supplied arrays replace the entire collection. A supplied schedule replaces the complete schedule and may switch timed/all-day modes. This is not a notification or dispatch tool. Inspect the order before retrying an uncertain write.

functions.name: upload-file
functions.description: Upload a small file and associate it with jobs or contacts, accepting ordinary text or exact binary bytes.

text.description: Ordinary text encoded internally as UTF-8; encoded bytes must not exceed 10 MiB.

isPrivate.description: Whether the file is private to its uploader; explicit to avoid choosing privacy policy.

fileTypeId.description: Account file type ID: 1 Document, 2 Photo, 3 Email Attachment, 4 naturalForms, 5 Invoice, 6 Eagleview, 7 Accurence, 8 Credit Memo, or an account custom type ID.

items.description: Existing related record ID.

relatedIds.description: Existing job/contact or other supported record IDs to associate; [] explicitly leaves no associations.

description.description: Optional ordinary-text file caption; omission leaves it unset and empty is explicit.

contentBase64.description: Exact binary file bytes in standard padded base64, decoded before transfer; decoded size must not exceed 10 MiB.

FunctionInput_jobnimbus_uploadfile.description: One small file with ordinary text or exact binary content and explicit association and privacy choices.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the uploaded attachment.

FunctionOutput_jobnimbus_uploadfile.description: The attachment identifier after storage accepts the uploaded bytes.

tags.instructions: Use this for a complete upload up to 10 MiB. Supply known related job/contact IDs. Use `import-file-from-url` for an existing publicly accessible image. Binary content uses standard base64 only to preserve exact bytes; text is ordinary Unicode. For larger externally transferred files use `create-multipart-upload`. Repeating this tool may create another attachment.
